checklist.notes: The language and task demands in the A1-U02-L01 SPEAKING AI-practice prompt are broadly appropriate for its declared CEFR tier.
No material English grammar, lexical, pronunciation-description, or meaning error was found in the reviewed A1-U02-L01 SPEAKING AI-practice prompt.
“Your partner is ready” and “work toward the stated goal” do not define an interlocutor situation; the model “Please help me” also omits the simple-time component of the compound goal.
The turn cap and one-question rule are coherent, but the opening, situation, goal, and feedback references do not form a fully aligned actionable roleplay.
“Work toward the stated goal” is opaque learner-facing language because the opening does not actually state that goal or establish a concrete partner situation.

No suspiciously distinctive copied passage is apparent in the short A1-U02-L01 SPEAKING AI-practice prompt, but internal inspection cannot establish originality beyond the retained project evidence and no Internet-wide comparison was performed.

findings.description: “Your partner is ready” and “work toward the stated goal” do not define an interlocutor situation; the model “Please help me” also omits the simple-time component of the compound goal.
findings.recommendation: Name a concrete situation and partner need, then prompt one in-role response that can elicit both the request and time reference.

limitations: This review covers only the immutable A1-U02-L01 SPEAKING AI-practice prompt and its fresh static machine-report context. It does not assess human or release approval, provider authentication, live-provider behavior, learner outcomes, or Internet-wide originality.
